value.rationale: This is a natural stability refinement of a newly sharp harmonic-analysis inequality: it turns qualitative non-extremality of every finite non-singleton into a computable gap determined by elementary support geometry, while simultaneously identifying the finite equality family. The dependence on m and the terminal support gap makes the statement usable in near-extremizer analysis rather than being a routine numerical recomputation.
